propositions: Git probes in tests/_isolation.py (porcelain and head) invoked subprocess.run with no timeout, allowing blocked children to keep pytest alive indefinitely after test completion
The real pytest_sessionfinish hook and autouse _no_repo_commits fixture both call unbounded git probes that can hang the test process
Measured normal repo-isolation probe latency (p95 0.0164s, max 0.0610s) permits a fixed 5-second watchdog without false positives
TimeoutExpired must be explicitly re-raised and surfaced as an isolation-infrastructure failure rather than collapsed to None like ordinary probe failures
Test-local monkeypatches of subprocess.run contaminate autouse teardown; binding the real runner at import prevents monkeypatch replacement of the safety guard
